shortDescription: The CAC 40 Index fell 3 points or 0.04 percent on Friday to close at 8283 points.Leading the losses are Dassault Systemes (-6.49%), Capgemini (-3.27%) and Publicis (-2.75%).Top gainers were Legrand (3.28%), STMicroelectronics (2.65%) and Accor (2.47%).
